\section{A. Grothendieck's Long March across the Theory of Galois}
``This manuscript, consisting of some nearly 800 hand-written double pages, dating from 1981, was left behind with Grothendieck's other unpublished manuscripts when he disappeared in 1991. Typed in Tex, it comes out to about 400 pages. It goes together with a further 1,000 pages or so of additional notes and sections which have not yet been read or typed. Many of the major themes were summarised in the 1983 manuscript {\em Esquisse d'un Programme.}''
The Table of Contents for this important work by Alexander Grothendieck was originally compiled in French by the author and is reproduced here after the English Translation of the major parts of the Long March.
